Since the biologic injection started in September, the stiffness in my hands lasts about ninety minutes after I wake, down from about three hours. My rheumatologist does not think the dose needs to change yet, and she wants a blood test before the next review. I inject every second Friday, and the next one is on the 14th.

Please do not move my Thursday duty slot; Valentina Pizarro already swapped it with me once, and I owe her the Friday morning supervision. Our head of department, Ignacio Bravo, wants the final timetable by the 20th, even if the lab question is still open.

Tomás Quiroga drives from Merlo on Mondays and Thursdays and has two free seats. Lucía Ferreyra could take the Tuesday run if her shift at the lab stays at 7:30; she has not confirmed yet.

The Sarmiento line pass costs 19,800 pesos for the month. On Wednesdays I need to be in Once by 7:15 for the delivery check, so the train is the only option that day.

text: I ride the e-bike from Maipú to the office three days a week and drive on the other two, mostly because the bike lane ends at the Costanera. Gonzalo Vidal in facilities said the bike shed is full until March, and Paula Ríos from safety says the stairwell is not an acceptable place to leave the bike, so I need a decision before the audit. My multiple sclerosis makes the walk from the visitor car park, about 400 metres, impossible on days with fatigue, and the neurologist wrote that I should park as near the lift as possible. The e-bike cost 1,280,000 pesos, and the company scheme repays it over ten months if I submit the invoice by 30 November. I will not be driving at all in January because the car goes in for repairs. text: The checkout API started returning 502 errors at 02:10 on Saturday after the certificate for the payments gateway expired. Renewing the certificate at 03:05 fixed the errors, and no orders were lost. The renewal was blocked for 40 minutes because the engineer paged first, Antonella Roca, did not have access to the vault, and Abril Cuello from platform granted temporary access at 02:55. Federico Maldonado, our usual on-call engineer, is on secondment to the data team until 20 June, so escalations on his rota currently go to Antonella. The expiry alert fired correctly 14 days ahead but went to Federico's old pager rule, which nobody has moved yet. I did not check the staging gateway, so I cannot say whether it has the same problem.
